clips.title: The story
paras: Alba Fairmoon sends you across Westfall to test the farm wells. The samples may reveal what is poisoning the soil and groundwater.

Alba Fairmoon asks you to test Westfall's groundwater. Neglect and banditry have already hurt the open plains, and poison beneath the earth threatens the farmland that remains. You collect samples from farm wells so Alba can learn what is tainting the soil and water.

You take samples from the wells at Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm. These homesteads lie among scattered farms exposed to Defias outlaws and feral wildlife. Their well water can show whether the blight is rising from the ground, caused by magic, or deliberately put into the water that feeds the region.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.
Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
